structures.label: First dorsal interosseous of foot
structures.description: Two heads from adjacent metatarsals 1 and 2; insertion on the medial side of toe 2.
structures.limitations: Thin educational fascicle paths, not a segmented muscle outline. Attachment breadth and expansion are simplified.
structures.recommendedRendering: tapered muscle ribbons; preserve the two heads

structures.label: Second dorsal interosseous of foot
structures.description: Two heads from adjacent metatarsals 2 and 3; insertion on the lateral side of toe 2.
structures.limitations: Thin educational fascicle paths, not a segmented muscle outline. Attachment breadth and expansion are simplified.
structures.recommendedRendering: tapered muscle ribbons; preserve the two heads

structures.label: Third dorsal interosseous of foot
structures.description: Two heads from adjacent metatarsals 3 and 4; insertion on the lateral side of toe 3.
structures.limitations: Thin educational fascicle paths, not a segmented muscle outline. Attachment breadth and expansion are simplified.
structures.recommendedRendering: tapered muscle ribbons; preserve the two heads

structures.label: Fourth dorsal interosseous of foot
structures.description: Two heads from adjacent metatarsals 4 and 5; insertion on the lateral side of toe 4.
structures.limitations: Thin educational fascicle paths, not a segmented muscle outline. Attachment breadth and expansion are simplified.
structures.recommendedRendering: tapered muscle ribbons; preserve the two heads

structures.label: Extensor digitorum brevis
pathRoles: EDB tendon joining EDL to toe 2
EDB tendon joining EDL to toe 3
EDB tendon joining EDL to toe 4
structures.description: The three EDB slips reach the lateral margins of EDL tendons for toes 2–4. EHB is already separately represented.
structures.limitations: Other origin contributions from the talocalcaneal ligament and inferior extensor retinaculum are described, not drawn. Tendon junction positions are approximate; no fifth-toe tendon invented.
structures.recommendedRendering: tapered three-slip muscle, no fourth hallux duplicate

structures.label: Articularis genus
structures.description: Several small bundles arise on the anterior distal femoral shaft and attach to the proximal knee synovial reflection.
structures.limitations: The synovial reflection has no segmented source mesh; distal endpoints are approximate. This is not a quadriceps-tendon or patellar insertion.
structures.recommendedRendering: three slender tapered muscle slips; source-marked schematic

structures.label: Psoas minor
pathRoles: T12 origin, belly and long pelvic tendon
structures.description: Optional slender muscle from T12–L1 bodies/disc to the iliopubic region and iliac fascia. It does not cross the hip joint.
structures.limitations: Presence varies. Its belly and tendon are reconstructed; the source has no psoas-minor surface. It must not be counted as a constituent of iliopsoas.
structures.recommendedRendering: short superior belly plus long thin tendon

structures.label: Hamstring part of adductor magnus
structures.description: Medial ischiocondylar part descends from the ischial tuberosity to the adductor tubercle and is supplied by the tibial division of the sciatic nerve.
structures.limitations: A schematic fascicle over the existing whole adductor magnus; not a new separated scan. Do not delete or claim complete segmentation of the whole muscle.
structures.recommendedRendering: tapered fascicle, distinguish from parent whole-muscle mesh

structures.label: Lumbar plexus
structures.description: Network of L1–L4 ventral rami in posterior psoas major with the major named lumbar branches. L4 also contributes to the lumbosacral trunk.
structures.limitations: Diagrammatic root-to-branch connectivity, not a solid plexus surface. Contributions may share a nerve trunk in life; displayed connectors are not separately dissectible cables. T12 contribution and smaller muscular branches are not drawn.

legacyGroupReplacement.policy: Use composite selection of new lumbar network, lumbosacral trunk and sacral network; hide the legacy generic three-strand plexus approximation.

structures.label: Lumbosacral trunk
structures.description: Part of L4 and all of L5 descend medial to psoas and across the anterior sacroiliac region to join the sacral plexus.
structures.limitations: Trunk caliber and root joining positions are approximate; no independent nerve scan exists.

structures.label: Sacral plexus
structures.description: Network of the lumbosacral trunk and S1–S4 ventral rami on the anterior surface of piriformis, with major sciatic, gluteal, posterior-femoral-cutaneous and pudendal pathways.
structures.limitations: This partial teaching network does not depict every small branch. Ventral and dorsal fibre divisions are not rendered as physically separated roots. It is not an opaque solid organ.

structures.label: Fibular communicating branch
structures.description: Common-fibular communicating contribution crosses lateral gastrocnemius to join the sural/medial-sural pathway.
structures.limitations: Union level and origin vary. This is a common teaching pattern; it must not be equated with the entire lateral sural cutaneous nerve.
structures.connectionNote: Existing procedural parent routes must meet the documented regional origin/union, rather than leaving a disconnected cable.

structures.label: Lateral calcaneal branches
structures.description: Cutaneous branches of the sural nerve to the lateral heel.
structures.limitations: Branch number and cutaneous arborization are illustrative. Not the medial calcaneal tibial branches and not the inferior calcaneal (Baxter) nerve.

structures.label: Superficial branch of lateral plantar nerve
structures.description: Distal superficial lateral-plantar branch supplies lateral one-and-a-half toes and associated lateral intrinsic targets.
structures.limitations: Digital branch courses are illustrative; muscular twigs and communication with medial plantar nerve are described, not all drawn.

structures.label: Deep branch of lateral plantar nerve
structures.description: Deep branch turns medially with the lateral plantar artery, deep to the flexor tendons and adductor hallucis, toward central intrinsic muscles.
structures.limitations: A simplified deep course; it does not assert exact branching to every lumbrical/interosseous. The fourth intermetatarsal-space interossei are supplied by the superficial branch in this source.

structures.label: Inferior calcaneal nerve
pathRoles: First lateral-plantar branch to abductor digiti minimi

source.title: Gray Anatomy 42nd edition
source.figure: Nerve entrapment syndromes: first lateral-plantar branch (Baxter)

structures.description: First branch of the lateral plantar nerve, passing deep to abductor hallucis toward abductor digiti minimi.
structures.limitations: Source text verifies identity and abductor-hallucis relation; no native detailed route figure or nerve scan was found. This short regional route cannot be used to localize an entrapment or surgical corridor.
aliases: first branch of lateral plantar nerve

structures.label: Dorsal digital nerves

source.title: Gray Anatomy 42nd edition
source.figure: Superficial fibular nerve and digital nerve text

structures.description: Dorsal digital branches from superficial fibular nerves supply most dorsum; deep fibular supplies the first web space; sural supplies the lateral fifth toe.
structures.limitations: Distal sample branches with preserved parent territories, not a continuous source-segmented network. Variation is common. Nail beds and distal dorsal tips receive plantar digital contributions, not shown here.
structures.recommendedRendering: group selectable distal branches; show source parent in part labels; do not merge all origins

structures.label: Femoral triangle
structures.description: Inverted triangle bounded by inguinal ligament, sartorius and adductor longus; floor iliopsoas/pectineus, roof fascia lata.
structures.limitations: Only the boundary is drawn. The apex is a soft-tissue reconstruction and the frame is not the femoral sheath.

structures.label: Adductor hiatus
structures.description: Distal opening beside the femur in the adductor-magnus aponeurotic attachment allows femoral vessels to enter the popliteal fossa.
structures.limitations: Reduced mesh does not segment the tendinous hole. A regional open frame is shown, not a measured lumen; this is not the entire obturator foramen.

structures.label: Adductor canal
structures.description: Intermuscular canal from femoral triangle apex toward distal adductor magnus, bounded by vastus medialis, adductors and subsartorial fascia.
structures.limitations: Three open triangular section frames are instructional, not segmented lumen walls or a traversable catheter path. Saphenous nerve leaves before the adductor hiatus.
structures.recommendedRendering: open separated wire sections, no filled tube

structures.label: Popliteal fossa
structures.description: Posterior knee region bounded superiorly by hamstrings and inferiorly by the gastrocnemius heads.
structures.limitations: Posterior surface frame only. Depth, fat, floor and roof are not volumetrically segmented; vessel positions should come from their own meshes.

structures.label: Tarsal tunnel
structures.description: Posteromedial ankle passage deep to the flexor retinaculum carrying the tibial neurovascular bundle and flexor tendons.
structures.limitations: Open regional cross-section, not an exact lumen or compressed-nerve model. No other medial-heel nerve is substituted for the tibial bundle.

structures.label: Greater sciatic foramen
structures.description: Opening formed by the greater sciatic notch and sacrospinous/sacrotuberous boundaries. Piriformis passes through it and separates supra- and infrapiriform routes.
structures.limitations: Frame follows regional bone/ligament references; it does not segment the exact foramen edge. Sacral portions are external reference meshes rather than existing hip-bone vertices.

structures.label: Lesser sciatic foramen
structures.description: Lesser sciatic notch closed by sacrospinous and sacrotuberous ligament boundaries; obturator internus tendon turns through the opening.
structures.limitations: Regional wire outline, not an exact lumen. The boundary using the sacral ligament anchor is a schematic closure, not a new bony notch.

structures.label: Obturator canal
structures.description: Small passage at the superior obturator foramen between the pubic groove and obturator membrane, transmitting obturator nerve and vessels.
structures.limitations: The membrane is not segmented. Small open regional ring; exact shape and lumen diameter are not measured.

parentRouteCorrections.reason: The new superficial/deep branch origin is at the fifth-metatarsal base; the existing bounds-only nerve terminates too far toward the forefoot to connect exactly.

integrationRules: Do not describe reconstructed geometry as a scan.
Render plexuses as selectable branch networks, never opaque solids.
Render regions as open frames, never solid organs.
Keep existing whole adductor magnus when adding its fascicle overlay.
Baxter nerve is not either calcaneal cutaneous branch family.
An independent reviewer must validate regional placement and rendered geometry before enabling these targets.
